svg.text: BED v7 | build order | exploded reference module; mirror/repeat as stated below
BEDROOM WORKSHOP | mm | verify stock and purchased hardware before cutting | revision 2026-11-15
1. Use two Backer halves and two Upholstered Panel Base halves; each fits 4 x 8 stock.
2. Fix each backer half independently to suitable wall fixings. Align the centre seam.
3. Join substrate halves with the upholstery system chosen by the upholsterer.
4. Continuous foam/fabric conceals the seam. Maintain the modelled 50 mm total depth.
